qualifiers.scope: per account, across all on-demand streams in an AWS Region

evidence.quote: Enabling On-demand Advantage commits the account to at least 25MiB/s of data ingest and 25MiB/s of data retrieval across all on-demand streams.
On-demand Advantage is an account-level setting that unlocks more capabilities and provides a different pricing structure for all on-demand streams in an AWS Region.
